sentences.en: Compared with last year, this year's crops are much better.
sentences.zh: 与去年相比，今年的庄稼好多了。

sentences.en: The situation has improved considerably compared with what it was.
sentences.zh: 与之前的情况相比，情况有了显著改善。

sentences.en: Compared to New York, Tokyo is a much safer place.
sentences.zh: 与纽约相比，东京是一个更安全的地方。

senses.zh: 相比，匹敌；比较，区别；比拟（常与to连用）

mnemonic: 联想记忆：com（共同）+pare（看作pair，对）→放在一起对比→对比
